Home.eyebrow: Wasanni kyauta a yanar gizo cikin harshen Hausa · tambayoyin da fasahar hankali ta wucin gadi ta rubuta
Home.lifelinesSubtitle: Idan kun makale, taimako zai iya ceton wasanku. Ku yi amfani da su da hikima — tambayoyi mafi wuya suna zuwa a ƙarshe.
Home.howStep1Body: Ana rubuta tambayoyin ne domin harshenku da al'adunku, ba fassara ba ne.
Home.howStep2Body: Zaɓi A, B, C ko D, sannan ku tabbatar da amsarku ta ƙarshe.
Home.howStep3Body: 50:50, Tambayi Ƴan Kallo, Kira Aboki da Canza Tambaya.
Home.howStep4Body: Ku tafi gida da kuɗinku a kowane lokaci — ko ku ci gaba don neman miliyan.

Home.cultureTitle: Tambayoyin da ke magana da harshenku
Home.cultureBody: Marubucin tambayoyinmu na ƙirƙirarriyar basira yana ƙirƙirar sababbin tambayoyi kai tsaye a kowanne daga cikin harsuna 80, yana haɗa ilimin duniya da tarihi, adabi, labarin ƙasa da al'adun al'ummarku. Tambaya game da mawaƙin da kuka fi so ba za ta zama fassarar tambaya game da wani dabam ba.
Home.offlineTitle: Ku yi wasa ko'ina, har ma babu intanet
Home.offlineBody: Ku saka manhajar ku ci gaba da wasan Asali a jirgin sama ko a cikin mota: ana ajiye tambayoyi a harshenku a na'urarku kai tsaye. Makinku za su daidaita idan intanet ya dawo.
Home.badgesSubtitle: Kai matakan tsira, ci miliyan, ku riƙa wasa kowace rana — akwai lambobin yabo {count} da za a samu.
Home.categoriesSubtitle: Daga tarihi da kimiyya zuwa fina-finai, abinci da al'adunku na gida.
Home.faq1Answer: Ee. Duk yanayin wasa, duk harshe da duk taimako kyauta ne, kuma ba sai kun yi rajista ba kafin ku yi wasan Asali.
Home.faq2Answer: Marubucin tambayoyi na ƙirƙirarriyar basira ne ke rubuta su kai tsaye a harshenku, kuma ana duba kowace tambaya kai tsaye kafin ta isa wasan. Idan wani kuskure ya kuɓuta, za ku iya ba da rahoto da taɓawa ɗaya.
Home.faq3Answer: Amsa tambaya ta 5 daidai tana tabbatar muku da {havenOne}, tambaya ta 10 kuma tana tabbatar da {havenTwo}. Idan kuka yi kuskure a wata tambaya daga baya, za ku tafi da matakin tsira na ƙarshe da kuka wuce.
Home.faq4Question: Zan iya yin wasa ba tare da intanet ba?
Home.faq4Answer: Ee — wasan Asali yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba. Ana ajiye tambayoyi a harshenku a na'urarku kai tsaye, kuma wasannin da kuka yi ba tare da intanet ba za su daidaita idan kun sake haɗuwa. Maraton da Tseren Lokaci suna buƙatar intanet.
Home.faq5Question: Ta yaya zan shiga jadawalin gwaraza?
Home.faq5Answer: Ku shiga da Google ku yi wasan matsayi na Maraton ko Tseren Lokaci. Sabarmu tana duba kowace amsa, don haka jadawalin gwaraza yana da adalci.
Home.faq6Question: Shin wannan shi ne wasan hukuma na shirin talabijin?
Home.faq6Answer: A'a. Gasar Miloniya wasa ne mai zaman kansa da masoya suka ƙirƙira, wanda aka gina bisa tsarin shahararren shirin gasar tambayoyi.
Home.faqLanguageQuestion: Shin zan iya buga wasan “Wa yake son zama miloniya?” cikin harshen Hausa?
Home.faqLanguageAnswer: E — wannan ita ce sigar wasan ta Hausa. An rubuta kowace tambaya da Hausa ga masu jin Hausa maimakon fassara su, kuma kowane salo da tallafi kyauta ne. Wasan yana samuwa kuma cikin wasu harsuna 79.
Home.languagesSubtitle: Kowane harshe yana da nasa tambayoyin, waɗanda aka rubuta su asali — ba tare da fassara su ba.

classic.name: Asali
classic.description: Tsarin asali: tambayoyi goma sha biyar masu ƙara wuya, matakan tsira biyu, taimako huɗu da ƴancin tafiya da abin da kuka ci a kowane lokaci.

timeAttack.description: Ku amsa tambayoyi gwargwadon iyawarku kafin lokaci ya ƙare. Amsa da ba daidai ba ba ta kawo ƙarshen wasan — amma tana rage muku daƙiƙa 5.

descriptions.general: Ɗan komai da komai: tambayoyin da ke sa shirin gasar tambayoyi ya zama mai daɗi.
descriptions.history: Dauloli, masu ƙirƙira, muhimman sauye-sauye da mutanen da suka gina duniya — har da ƙasarku.
descriptions.geography: Manyan biranen ƙasashe, koguna, tsaunuka, tutoci da wuraren tarihi daga kowane lungu na taswira.
descriptions.science: Fiziks, kemistri, bayoloji, ilimin sararin samaniya da jikin ɗan Adam.
descriptions.nature: Dabbobi, tsirrai, yanayi da abubuwan al'ajabi na halitta.
descriptions.literature: Marubuta, mawaƙa, littattafan labari da jaruman da kowa ya sani.
descriptions.art: Masu zane, masu sassaƙa, shahararrun gine-gine da salon fasaha.
descriptions.music: Mawaƙa, makaɗa, kayan kiɗa da waƙoƙi na zamani daban-daban.
descriptions.filmTv: Fina-finai, shirye-shirye masu dogon zango, zane-zanen yara, ƴan wasan kwaikwayo da daraktoci.
descriptions.sports: Ƙungiyoyi, zakarun gasa, bajinta da ƙa'idojin wasa.
descriptions.technology: Kwamfutoci, intanet, na'urori da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙiren da ke bayansu.
descriptions.food: Abinci iri-iri, kayan haɗi da al'adun abinci daga ko'ina a duniya.
descriptions.mythology: Tatsuniyoyi, jarumai, labaran gargajiya da almarar al'ummomin da.
descriptions.language: Kalmomi, salon magana, karin magana da asalinsu.
descriptions.popCulture: Fitattun mutane, wasanni, sababbin abubuwan zamani da labaran da kowa ke magana a kai.
descriptions.localCulture: Al'adu, bukukuwa, fitattun mutane da rayuwar yau da kullum a inda ake magana da harshenku.

Rules.title: Yadda ake wasa
Rules.intro: Duk abin da kuke buƙatar sani game da yanayin wasa guda uku, matakan kyauta da taimako.
Rules.classicBody1: Za ku fuskanci tambayoyi goma sha biyar masu zaɓi, kowacce da amsoshi huɗu. Tambayoyin suna farawa da sauƙi kuma suna ƙara wuya yayin da kyautar ke ƙaruwa, daga {first} a tambaya ta 1 har zuwa {top} a tambaya ta 15.
Rules.classicBody2: Zaɓi amsa, sannan ku tabbatar da ita a matsayin amsarku ta ƙarshe. Idan daidai ne, za ku hau mataki ɗaya a matakan kyauta. Idan ba daidai ba ne, wasan ya ƙare.
Rules.safeHavensBody: Tambaya ta 5 da ta 10 matakan tsira ne. Da zarar kun amsa su daidai, an tabbatar muku da {havenOne} sannan {havenTwo} — kuskure daga baya zai mayar da ku zuwa matakin tsira na ƙarshe, ba sifili ba.
Rules.walkAwayBody: Kafin ku tabbatar da amsa, kuna iya tafiya ku riƙe duk abin da kuka ci zuwa yanzu. Wani lokaci tsayawa ce mafi hikima.
Rules.timerBody: A saurin shirin da aka saba, kuna samun daƙiƙa 30 don tambayoyi 1–5, daƙiƙa 45 don tambayoyi 6–10, da lokaci marar iyaka don biyar na ƙarshe. Kuna iya canza ko kashe agogon a saitunan wasa.
Rules.lifelinesBody: Kuna da taimako huɗu, kuma kowanne ana iya amfani da shi sau ɗaya a kowane wasa:
Rules.marathonBody: Wasa marar ƙarewa. Tambayoyi suna ƙara wuya bayan kowace amsa daidai biyar, kuna da taimako huɗu kowanne sau ɗaya, kuma kuna samun {minutes, plural, one {minti #} other {minti #}} ga kowace tambaya. Amsa ɗaya da ba daidai ba ko ƙarewar lokaci tana kawo ƙarshen wasan, kuma makinku shi ne yawan amsoshinku da suka yi daidai.
Rules.timeAttackBody: Kuna da daƙiƙa {seconds} don amsa tambayoyi gwargwadon iyawarku. Amsa da ba daidai ba ba ta kawo ƙarshen wasan, amma tana rage daƙiƙa {penalty} daga agogo. Babu taimako.
Rules.rankedBody: Sabarmu ce ke alƙalancin wasannin Maraton da Tseren Lokaci koyaushe: amsar da ta dace ba ta isa na'urarku kafin ku amsa, kuma a sabar ake riƙe agogo. Kowa zai iya yin su; ku shiga da Google don makinku ya shiga jadawalin gwaraza.
Rules.questionsBody: Marubucin tambayoyi na ƙirƙirarriyar basira ne ke rubuta tambayoyin kai tsaye a kowane harshe, kuma ana duba su kai tsaye. Kusan kashi 40% na tambayoyin suna game da al'adun inda ake magana da harshenku. Idan tambaya ta yi kamar ba daidai ba ce, yi amfani da “Ba da rahoton kuskure” bayan an bayyana amsar.

About.title: Game da Gasar Miloniya
About.intro: Gasar Miloniya wasan gasar tambayoyi ne na kyauta da masoya suka ƙirƙira, bisa tsarin shahararren shirin talabijin — an sake gina shi don yanar gizo, wayoyi da harsuna 80.
About.missionTitle: Dalilin da ya sa muka gina shi
About.missionBody: Yawancin wasannin gasar tambayoyi ana rubuta su da Turanci sannan a fassara su. Mun yi imani cewa gasar tambayoyi ya kamata ta ji kamar gida: tambayoyin su kasance game da mutane, wurare, littattafai da al'adun da kuka taso a cikinsu, tare da duniya baki ɗaya.
About.howBody: Babban tsarin harshe na ƙirƙirarriyar basira yana rubuta kowace tambaya kai tsaye a harshenku, rukuni-rukuni, yana bin ƙa'idoji masu tsauri: amsa ɗaya tak bayyananniya, zaɓuɓɓuka huɗu masu kama da gaskiya, da tabbatattun bayanai kawai. Ana tantance tambayoyin kai tsaye, a ajiye su, sannan a ba ƴan wasa; kowane ɗan wasa zai iya ba da rahoton kuskure.
About.techBody: Gasar Miloniya manhajar yanar gizo ce ta zamani: ana iya saka ta a wayarku ko kwamfutarku, tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba da tambayoyin da aka ajiye kai tsaye, kuma tana daidaita ci gabanku idan kun sake haɗuwa.
About.disclaimer: Gasar Miloniya ba ta da alaƙa da kowane shirin talabijin, gidan yaɗa labarai ko mai haƙƙin mallaka, kuma ba su amince da ita ko ɗaukar nauyinta ba.

Legal.privacyIntro: Muna tattara mafi ƙarancin bayanai. Wannan shafin yana bayyana abin da muke ajiyewa da dalili.
Legal.privacyDataBody: Idan kuna wasa ba tare da shiga ba, saitunanku, makinku da lambobin yabonku suna zama a na'urarku. Idan kun shiga da Google, muna ajiye adireshin imel ɗinku, lambar asusun Google ɗinku, sunan da ake nunawa, hoton shafinku da sakamakon wasanninku, don ci gabanku ya bi ku kuma jadawalin gwaraza ya nuna sunanku.
Legal.privacyUseBody: Ana amfani da bayananku ne kawai don gudanar da wasan: don nuna shafinku da matsayinku a jadawalin gwaraza da kuma adana ci gabanku. Ba za mu taɓa sayar da su ko raba su da masu talla ba.
Legal.privacyAnalyticsBody: Za mu iya amfani da nazari mai mutunta sirri da rahotannin kurakurai don fahimtar abubuwan da ake amfani da su da kuma gyara matsaloli. Waɗannan ba sa ƙunshe da abin da kuka amsa.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: Kuna iya canza sunan da ake nunawa da hotonku a kowane lokaci, kuma kuna iya neman mu goge asusunku da duk bayanan da ke tare da shi ta hanyar tuntuɓar mai ƙirƙirar wasan.
Legal.termsIntro: Ta hanyar yin wasan Gasar Miloniya, kun amince da waɗannan sharuɗɗa masu sauƙi.
Legal.termsPlayBody: Ku yi wasannin matsayi da gaskiya. Wasa ta na'ura mai sarrafa kanta, cin moriyar kurakuran manhaja ko yin katsalandan a jadawalin gwaraza na iya sa a cire wasanninku.
Legal.termsContentBody: Ana ƙirƙirar tambayoyin kai tsaye kuma wani lokaci suna iya ƙunsar kurakurai. An samar da su ne don nishaɗi kawai. Kuɗaɗen kyauta na kwaikwayo ne — babu kuɗi na gaske a ciki.
Legal.termsNamesBody: Kada ku yi amfani da sunaye ko hotuna masu ɓatanci, masu yin sojan gona da sunan wasu, ko masu keta haƙƙin kowa. Za mu iya canza su ko cire su.

Seo.keywords: wasan wa yake son zama miloniya, wa yake son zama miloniya cikin harshen Hausa, wasan miloniya a yanar gizo, gasar miloniya, wasan tambayoyi, tambayoyin kyauta, ƙalubale
Seo.homeTitle: Wa yake son zama miloniya? Wasan kyauta a yanar gizo cikin harshen Hausa | Gasar Miloniya
Seo.homeDescription: Ku buga “Wa yake son zama miloniya?” kyauta a yanar gizo cikin harshen Hausa: tambayoyi 15 zuwa ga milon ɗaya, tallafi huɗu da wuraren tsira biyu, tare da tambayoyin da aka rubuta da Hausa, ba tare da an fassara su ba. Babu rajista. Kuma a cikin wasu harsuna 79.
Seo.playTitle: Gasar Miloniya ta Asali — tambayoyi 15 zuwa miliyan
Seo.playDescription: Hau matakan kyauta daga {first} zuwa {top}: tambayoyi goma sha biyar, matakan tsira biyu, taimako huɗu. Kyauta, babu rajista, a harshenku.
Seo.marathonTitle: Gasar tambayoyi ta Maraton — har yaushe za ku jure?
Seo.marathonDescription: Gasar tambayoyi marar ƙarewa da ke ƙara wuya bayan kowace amsa biyar. Kuskure ɗaya yana kawo ƙarshen wasan. Ku fafata a jadawalin gwaraza na Maraton na duniya.
Seo.timeAttackTitle: Gasar tambayoyi ta Tseren Lokaci — daƙiƙa {seconds} kuna fafatawa da agogo
Seo.timeAttackDescription: Amsa tambayoyi gwargwadon iyawarku cikin daƙiƙa {seconds}. Amsoshin da ba daidai ba suna rage lokaci. Ku hau jadawalin gwaraza na Tseren Lokaci na duniya.
Seo.leaderboardTitle: Jadawalin Gwaraza — mafi kyawun ƴan wasan gasar tambayoyi a duniya
Seo.leaderboardDescription: Matsayin Maraton da Tseren Lokaci na duniya, da za a iya tacewa ta harshe. Nemo ƴan wasa ku ga wanda ke kan gaba a wannan makon.
Seo.categoriesTitle: Rukunan tambayoyi — tarihi, kimiyya, fina-finai, wasanni da sauransu
Seo.categoriesDescription: Rukunan tambayoyi goma sha shida masu tambayoyin da aka rubuta kai tsaye a harshenku, daga tarihin duniya zuwa al'adunku na gida.
Seo.categoryDescription: Gwada kanku da tambayoyin {category} a harshenku. {description}
Seo.badgesTitle: Lambobin Yabo — ku tattara su duka
Seo.badgesDescription: Lambobin yabo ashirin da za a samu a Asali, Maraton da Tseren Lokaci: ci miliyan, riƙa wasa kowace rana, yi wasa a harsuna da yawa.
Seo.rulesTitle: Yadda ake wasa — ƙa'idoji, matakan kyauta da taimako
Seo.rulesDescription: Cikakkun ƙa'idojin Gasar Miloniya: matakan kyauta, matakan tsira, tafiya da kuɗi, taimako huɗu, Maraton da Tseren Lokaci.
Seo.aboutDescription: Wasan gasar tambayoyi na kyauta da masoya suka ƙirƙira, mai tambayoyin da ƙirƙirarriyar basira ta rubuta a harsuna 80, bisa tsarin shahararren shirin gasar tambayoyi na talabijin.
Seo.privacyDescription: Abin da Gasar Miloniya ke ajiyewa, dalili, da yadda ake goge shi.
Seo.termsDescription: Ƙa'idoji masu sauƙi don yin wasan Gasar Miloniya cikin adalci.
Seo.contactDescription: Tambayoyi, shawarwari ko kuskure a wata tambaya? Aika saƙo ga ƙungiyar Gasar Miloniya.
Seo.signInDescription: Ku shiga da Google don sanya makinku a jadawalin gwaraza da adana ci gabanku a kowace na'ura.
Seo.settingsDescription: Sauti, harshe da saitunan wasan Asali.
